en.name: YOLO7 Tony
en.description: A 24-year-old Vietnamese young man speaking English with a noticeable Vietnamese accent. Cheerful, energetic and over-confident, talks fast, playful and funny. Clean studio recording.
en.sample_text: Yo, Tín! I'm here, I'm here! Don't worry, I speak English very good. Hello sir, you want pho? Pho number one in Saigon! I bring for you now, easy game! Oh wait, small or big? Sorry, sorry, I change now!
